_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Score has moved 0 of 59 12h windows by ±2+ points over 7 days — this is a textbook coil where HOLD with conviction is the statistically honest call until a breaker fires.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst explicitly calls HOLD with medium conviction; narrative writer implies an imminent accumulation entry. Split reconciled by leaning to the higher-trust analyst's HOLD.
next_move.confirmed_if: ETF flows resume >40 with DXY breaking below 100 and BTC momentum >60 (confirms UP leg to Complacency)
next_move.invalidated_if: VIX spikes above 22 with funding flipping negative (confirms DOWN leg to Panic)
